common.crashBody: The app hit an unexpected error. You can try again.

errors.timeout: The server took too long to respond.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.empty: You don't have any positions yet.
portfolio.emptyHint: Buy an instrument from the Market tab.

orders.title: Orders
orders.empty: You haven't sent any orders yet.
orders.emptyHint: Tap an instrument in Market to trade.

explanation.FILLED_MARKET: It executed right away at {{price}} per share.
explanation.FILLED_LIMIT: The market reached your limit price of {{price}} and the order executed.
explanation.PENDING: The order stays open until the market accepts your limit price. This list refreshes every 15 seconds while an order is pending.
explanation.REJECTED: The market doesn't report the reason for a rejection. Common causes: not enough cash (buy) or shares (sell) when the order arrived, or a limit price the market didn't accept. You can send it again with other values.

order.title: Trade {{ticker}}

typeHint.MARKET: Executes now at the last price.
typeHint.LIMIT: Stays pending until the market accepts your price.

order.switchToAmount: Enter an amount in ARS instead
order.switchToQuantity: Enter a number of shares instead
order.offline: You need a connection to send an order.
order.maybeSent: We lost the connection while sending. The order may have gone through: check Orders before you try again.

result.title: Order sent
result.PENDING: Your order is pending in the market.

errors.quantityFractional: Fractional shares aren't allowed. Enter a whole number.
errors.amountTooSmall: That amount doesn't buy a single share.
errors.priceRequired: Enter a limit price greater than 0.
errors.insufficientShares: You don't have enough shares to sell.

account.title: Account
account.candidateIdHint: The API isolates your portfolio and orders by this identifier.
account.resetHint: Deletes your orders and holdings. Back to 1,000,000 ARS.
account.darkModeHint: Follows your phone's setting until you change it here.
